episodes.synopsis: Yuzuka is starting to get used to using water magic, but when Chiya asks her if there's any benefit to being a magical girl, she's shaken by the fact that she can't answer.
episodes.title: Has Anything Good Happened for You Since You Became a Magical Girl?

episodes.synopsis: Yuzuka has improved her magic to the point where she can show everyone, but when she compares her swimsuit to Mafuyu's she can't help feeling something's off. What does Mafuyu say to Yuzuka?!
episodes.title: Having a Swimsuit Is Weird

episodes.synopsis: Everyone is surprised by Mafuyu's announcement about her retirement and her successor, and also about Chiya's sudden transformation. Once everything settles down a bit, Chiya asks Yuzuka something.
episodes.title: Magical Girl Chiya Is Here-Chiya!

episodes.synopsis: Pochi's scheme allows Chiya and Yuzuka to hold a tea party under the guise of a study group session. Wanting to share her happiness, Chiya invites Mafuyu.
episodes.title: Would You Like to Admire and Appreciate Yuzuka with Me?

episodes.synopsis: Mafuyu started the party, which now includes Daiya, by acting the grand senior member with experience, but now...?!
episodes.title: I`ll Teach You Anything You Don`t Know

episodes.synopsis: With the cafe air conditioning broken, Mafuyu asks Yuzuka to transform. Once it starts to cool down nicely, everyone decides to play together?!
episodes.title: Because I Can`t Stay in This Outfit

episodes.synopsis: This episode is about Daiya-chan. Daiya was playing at the park when Yuzuka and Chiya invite her to the cafe. She has a special skill no one knows about. What could it be?!
episodes.title: I Think She Can See Too Much

episodes.synopsis: One day, at the cafe, Yuzuka and Chiya decide to ask Miton lots of questions about himself. Miton begins telling them about his past...
episodes.title: You`re Asking About Me?

episodes.synopsis: This episode is about Yuzuka's dad. Yuzuka's dad, looking completely exhausted, loosens his tie. As he looks up at the beautiful colors of the sunrise sky... he is enveloped by light?!
episodes.title: I Will Work! For My Family!!

episodes.synopsis: At Daiya-chan's invitation, everyone decides to go to the beach. Chiya and Mafuyu try a lot of different things to help Yuzuka get used to wearing a swimsuit, some more successful than others. For a moment, everyone enjoys the romance of it, but then...
episodes.title: The... Beach?

episodes.synopsis: Daiya-chan's in a tough spot?! Noticing something seems strange, Yuzuka and Mafuyu transform!! They combine their powers to go rescue her, but...
episodes.title: Chosen Ones! It`s Time for You to Join Forces and Save the Captured Princess!

episodes.synopsis: Is Daiya-chan all right?! And what is the reason Yuzuka has found for being a magical girl?! And now, the final episode of the second season!!
episodes.title: Why I`m Glad I Became a Magical Girl
